name: Prayer to Elune
summary: A spirit held in a cage in Searing Gorge, Zamael Lunthistle, asks if you will help him. He has not had visitors in many years, and first wants you to hear his tale.

sections.title: A Spirit in a Cage
sections.body: Zamael Lunthistle greets you with a praise to Elune and says that many years have passed since anyone visited him. He asks if you will help, and begins with a request that you hear his tale.

sections.title: Zamael's Tale
sections.body: Zamael was a young night elf from Darkshore when he fell in with the Twilight's Hammer, who befriended him and turned him from Elune. A vision from Elune woke him from the malaise of following the old gods, and in repentance he etched his sorrow into a tablet of pure gold as a prayer to Elune. The Twilight's Hammer found the tablet, branded him a blasphemer and had him executed, his prayer unfinished. He is now bound to the world as a spirit and held in the cage as a warning to all who would betray the Twilight's Hammer's faith. Zamael has accepted his fate, but says the prayer must be found.

aliases: who is the ghost in the cage
faq.answer: Zamael Lunthistle is a spirit held in a cage in Searing Gorge. He asks you to hear his tale.

faq.q: What does Zamael ask of you?
faq.answer: He asks if you will assist him, and first that you hear his tale.

faq.q: What comes after hearing Zamael's tale?
faq.answer: A second part of Prayer to Elune follows, again with Zamael.
